hypothesis: The randomly initialized additive hidden modulation makes the initial usable basis harder to learn on the jointly reachable teacher. Neutralizing only H and b at fresh initialization improves convergence while retaining the particle gate.
prior_evidence: The frozen three-arm parent reproduced the gap under all four common learned critics. Native G and table scales stayed at one; the router visited 0.5 and returned to one. Noise stayed at 0.125, and there were no surprise fires or accepted structural moves. The teacher shares the ordinary initial down basis; V3 adds an unrelated nonlinear hidden term to that basis. Actual Supra early captures show larger hidden modulation than linear hidden at a minority of sites; this is context, not proof of this cause.
changed_factor: After the same public named sampled initialization, set ONLY both bridge H column slices and bridge bias b to zero before constructing the native policy. Keep sampled C nonzero and all H/b trainable.
data_contract: Byte-identical teacher, fit/guard/test tensors, frozen host, scales and all input/paired streams from the parent. Only initial_particle H/b tensors and explicit intervention metadata differ; new data identity is recomputed before policy construction.
initialization_gate: All initial FAST/EMA G tensors equal the parent except the declared H/b slices; C/down/up/router/bank/critic and all native initial owner states match. Fresh full outputs remain exactly neutral. Retained bank/router gradients must become nonzero after the zero-up start.

execution.stopping: fixed external horizon or operational budget only; no checkpoint, horizon, seed or head selection

evaluation.law: Use every parent frozen judge and the exact same four private paired Gaussian panels at sigma 0.125, clean FAST outputs without DV12; preserve all fixed 200-step curves.
evaluation.support_gate: The fixed 6400 test game improves by more than 1e-4 under ALL FOUR original common judges, and cuts the parent particle-minus-ordinary gap by at least half under BOTH endpoint judges. This supports the initialization mechanism on this teacher family; no default or Supra quality claim follows.
evaluation.particle_gate: Final C is nonzero and trainable, bank/router acquired nonzero gradients, and the final zero-code ablation changes mean test game by more than 1e-6 under ALL FOUR parent judges. Report its direction without selecting judges. No particle-removal configuration is promoted.
evaluation.output_error: diagnostic only; never optimizer, row criterion, selection or stopping

storage: Keep run.log, traces, checkpoints and per-context scores local; track sources, compact receipts and explanation.
qualification_credit: none; no Forge/default/Supra qualification; no automatic follow-up arms
